title: H4470 (125th General Assembly): Omnibus More Justice Act

other_topics: judicial-bail-pretrial: SECTION 5.A (Section 17-15-55) and Sections 17-15-30, 22-5-510, new 17-15-270 — bond rules for repeat offenders, surety limits, mental health evaluation before bond hearing
judicial-police-accountability: Section 6 (new Section 23-1-255) excessive-force felony; Section 8 (new Section 23-1-270) taser and stun gun policy and reporting
judicial-criminal-justice: Section 3 (new Chapter 32, Title 17) asset forfeiture and private property protection
public-safety-approach: Section 7 (new Section 23-1-260) ban on agencies acquiring military items such as armored vehicles and weaponized drones
judicial-transparency: Section 1 (new Chapter 32, Title 14) Judicial Criminal Information Technology Committee

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, South Carolina); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official South Carolina text (Introduced, 2023-05-10; official copy, https://www.scstatehouse.gov/sess125_2023-2024/prever/4470_20230510.htm (LegiScan doc 2805037))
provenance.note: Introduced version (2023-05-10); no passage vote on record. Not quoted but gun-related: Section 3 (new Section 17-32-30 etc.) lets the State forfeit firearms and ammunition used in a crime and requires firearms to be sold to licensed dealers; SECTION 5.A (Section 17-15-55) adds "felony offense involving a firearm" to repeat-offender bond rules and requires full cash deposit for bonds set after two prior firearm or violent bonds.
